collegeFullAddress: 164, Backbay Reclamation, H.T. Parekh Marg, Churchgate, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400020
collegeInfo: Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS), founded in 1965, is the management department of the University of Mumbai and consistently ranked among the top B-schools in India. Known as the 'CEO Factory', JBIMS has produced leading professionals in business, consulting, and finance. The institute’s industry-oriented curriculum, excellent faculty, and Mumbai location provide superior exposure and job opportunities for students.

events.eventFullDescription: METANOIA is JBIMS's flagship management festival that blends business acumen, innovation, and cultural vibrancy. The fest features flagship events like business case competitions, quizzes, workshops, as well as cultural performances attracting participants from premier B-schools nationwide.
Strategym is JBIMS’s pan-India consulting conclave featuring keynote sessions from top consulting professionals, live case study competitions, and panel discussions.

infrastructure.infraDescription:
JBIMS is housed in an iconic red-brick building at Churchgate, Mumbai. Despite being centrally located in the city, the campus provides a conducive environment for learning and professional development.

Academic Infrastructure

  • Lecture Halls: Modern, spacious, and ICT-enabled halls facilitate interactive learning.

  • A vast library with 50,000+ books, journals, digital resources, and database subscriptions including Bloomberg and EBSCO.

Residential Facilities

  • Hostel: Limited hostel facilities available for outstation students through Mumbai University, more students opt for off-campus apartments due to location convenience.

Recreation & Amenities

  • Student Cafeteria: Multi-cuisine options available within campus premises.

  • Sports: Access to University of Mumbai's sporting facilities (cricket, football, tennis, gymnasium).
